_comment: Per-refraction icon codes, language-neutral. 'set' is the scenario's encounter-set symbol shown in the diamond above the type line (built by tools/scenario_icons.py from the artist's vector sheets); 'collection' is the product/box symbol in the bottom corner. Both are SVG names under assets/products/. A chapter-1 refraction whose 'collection' is omitted gets its campaign symbol derived from the FAQ's own campaign-icon table (see tools/ub_cap1.py); a campaign-wide refraction has no 'set' at all.
